mcqs.question: In the context of Andhra Pradesh’s natural-farming initiative, which incident involving Guntur chilli was reported?
options: China returned 3 containers of Guntur chilli over pesticide residues
China returned 3 containers of Guntur chilli due to excessive moisture
Japan rejected Guntur chilli over pesticide residues
China accepted Guntur chilli after natural-farming certification
mcqs.explanation: China returned 3 containers of Guntur chilli because of pesticide residues. The reported issue was pesticide residues, not excessive moisture or rejection by Japan.
